findings.explanation: Intellectual property transfers immediately upon creation or via work-made-for-hire terms without explicitly conditioning the transfer on full payment, which creates a risk that you create work but do not get paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment, all ownership rights in the Product Collateral IP created by the Contractor shall be assigned to the Client.

findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations are entirely excluded from the liability cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial liability.
findings.suggested_change: The maximum liability of each party in any way related to this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement, including all indemnification obligations.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of adjustments before I sign it. - Regarding the clause stating that intellectual property transfers immediately upon creation, this creates a situation where ownership is assigned before payment is received. I propose updating this so that ownership rights in the Product Collateral IP created by the contractor are assigned to the client only upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the limitation of liability clause, the current wording excludes indemnification obligations from the liability cap, which exposes me to unlimited financial liability. I propose that the maximum liability of each party in any way related to this agreement should not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this agreement, including all indemnification obligations. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can move forward. Best regards.
